3: Native Weather Icons Master Board v74 - Smooth Uniform Rain Caps
4: Based on v73. All fourteen native circle.fill rain caps use the same physical diameter as their unchanged body width. Cap centres are calculated from the rotated body endpoints with the 1134:1182 display aspect, without per-stroke pixel snapping. This removes geometric width and alignment differences at the joins. Body frames, rotation 30, colours, spacing and all other layers are unchanged. Native Widgy rendering must be checked on-device; different display aspect ratios require recalibration.
